description: Live foreign-exchange reference rates from the European Central Bank (ECB), updated every business day. Convert between 30+ currencies (USD, EUR, GBP, JPY, CNY and more) with a single call: pass base and symbols, get mid-market reference rates as clean JSON. Rates are the ECB daily reference rates, the same source banks and accounting tools cite. Free reference data, republished with attribution.
